      USAGE_QUERY
      "SELECT i.ingredient_name, SUM(od.order_qty * cd.servings * mid.ingredient_quantity) AS used FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN combo_details cd ON cd.order_detail_id = od.order_detail_id JOIN menu_item_details mid ON mid.menu_item_id = cd.menu_item_id JOIN ingredients i ON i.ingredient_id = mid.ingredient_id WHERE o.order_status = \'paid\' AND o.created_at::date BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY i.ingredient_name ORDER BY i.ingredient_name"

      private static final String
      SALES_QUERY
      "SELECT mi.menu_item_name, SUM(od.order_qty * cd.servings) AS quantity_sold, COALESCE(SUM(od.order_qty * cd.servings * COALESCE(mi.premium_charge, 0)), 0) AS premium_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN combo_details cd ON cd.order_detail_id = od.order_detail_id JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_item_id = cd.menu_item_id WHERE o.order_status = \'paid\' AND o.created_at::date BETWEEN ? AND ? AND (? = 0 OR mi.menu_item_id = ?) GROUP BY mi.menu_item_id, mi.menu_item_name ORDER BY mi.menu_item_name"
